verdict.rationale: Composio is a SaaS integration platform that handles user data and credentials, so a training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The credential-storage and session-restriction docs are about other capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
